content.title: Is stock market open today, Good Friday 2026? Is stock market closed today for a federal holiday?
content.text: Updated April 3, 2026, 8:50 a.m. ETGood Friday is not a federal holiday, but U.S. stock markets are closed.Most banks, the USPS, and UPS will operate on Good Friday.FedEx will have modified service on the holiday.Good Friday is recognized as a state holiday in Indiana, closing state government offices.Hoping to make a few trades on the stock markets today?Not on Good Friday, even though the religious holiday is not considered a federal holiday.Here's what will be open or closed on Good Friday from banks and USPS mail delivery to the stock market:Is Good Friday a federal holiday today in the U.S.?Good Friday is not specified by law to be one of the 12 federal holidays recognized in 2026, according to opm.gov.Is the stock market open today, Good Friday, April 3, 2026? Is stock market closed today?The stock markets on New York Stock Exchange and the Nasdaq are closed for trading on Good Friday, April 3, 2026. The Securities Industry and Financial Markets Association also recommended an early close at noon EST for the holiday.Will banks be closed on Good Friday, April 3, 2026? Are banks open today?Most banks will be open on Good Friday, April 3, 2026, according to The Federal Reserve.Is USPS post office open on Good Friday, April 3, 2026? Will mail be delivered today?The United States Postal Service will be open, and mail will be delivered on Good Friday, April 3, 2026.Is FedEx open today on Good Friday, April 3, 2026?FedEx and FedEx Freight will have modified service on Good Friday, April 3, 2026, but all other delivery options are expected to operate as normal.Is UPS open today on Good Friday, April 3, 2026?UPS Store is open and UPS delivery and pickup services are available on Good Friday, April 3, 2026.Is Good Friday a state holiday in Indiana?Good Friday is a state holiday in Indiana. State government offices will be closed.Are Indiana schools closed today on Good Friday?Some schools may close on Good Friday, but several will remain open in Indiana. Be sure to check with your local school for details.Chris Sims is a trending reporter at Midwest Connect Gannett. Follow him on Twitter: @ChrisFSims.
